$description: Design tokens exported from the Figma file "My project" (bHRn6PCs8dDNpgPaYAnZ0p). W3C DTCG format. $value holds the first mode; every mode is listed in $extensions.figma.modes. Regenerate CSS with `npm run tokens`.

gap.$description: Space between a button label and its icon.

padding-x.$description: Left and right padding of primary and secondary buttons.

padding-y.$description: Top and bottom padding of primary and secondary buttons.

padding-bottom.$description: Bottom padding of tertiary buttons – leaves room for the active/focus underline.

padding-top.$description: Top padding of tertiary (text-only) buttons, e.g. navigation links.

padding-x.$description: Left and right padding of tertiary buttons – keeps the clickable area wider than the text.

padding-y.$description: Top and bottom padding of a project card. Horizontal padding comes from page/padding-x.

gap-400.$description: Space between a heading group and the content that follows it, e.g. text block ↔ button in About.

gap-300.$description: Space between elements inside a content block, e.g. headline ↔ paragraph ↔ link in a card.

gap-200.$description: Tight spacing within small groups, e.g. skill title ↔ description, or subtitle ↔ title in Hero.

gap-100.$description: Smallest content spacing for closely related elements, e.g. icon ↔ label or stacked metadata.

gap.$description: Space between items in the footer, e.g. copyright ↔ Contact link.

padding-y.$description: Top and bottom padding of the footer.
Top and bottom padding of the Hero section. Larger than section/padding-y to give the page title room.

gap.$description: Space between navigation links and the contact button.

padding-y.$description: Top and bottom padding of the navigation bar.

padding-x.$description: Left and right page margin – applied to every full-width section (Navigation, Hero, ProjectCard, About, Skills) so all content lines up on one edge.

gap.$description: Space between the main blocks inside a section, e.g. image ↔ content in cards and About, or between skill columns.

padding-y.$description: Top and bottom padding of a page section (About, Skills).

default.$description: Fill of primary buttons in the default state – the main call to action, e.g. “contact”.

hover.$description: Fill of primary buttons on hover.

icon.$description: Icon colour on primary buttons in every state.

pressed.$description: Fill of primary buttons while pressed (active state).

text.$description: Label colour on primary buttons in every state. Light in light mode, dark in dark mode for contrast.

bg.$description: Fill of secondary buttons – the same in every state.

default.$description: Border of secondary buttons in the default state.

hover.$description: Border of secondary buttons on hover.

icon.$description: Icon colour on secondary buttons in every state.

pressed.$description: Border of secondary buttons while pressed (active state).

text.$description: Label colour on secondary buttons in every state.

default.$description: Label colour of tertiary (text-only) buttons in the default and focus states, e.g. navigation links.

hover.$description: Label colour of tertiary buttons on hover.

icon.$description: Icon colour of tertiary buttons in the default, pressed and focus states.

icon-hover.$description: Icon colour of tertiary buttons on hover.

pressed.$description: Label colour of tertiary buttons while pressed (active state).

underline.$description: Underline of tertiary buttons in the active and focus states.

hero.$description: Background of the Hero section only.

inverse.$description: Contrasting background that closes the page, e.g. the footer. Always pair with text/inverse.

page.$description: Default page background – sections, navigation and the page frame. Base layer everything else sits on.

surface.$description: Raised surface on top of bg/page, e.g. the logo tile. White in light mode, slightly lighter than the page in dark mode.

warm.$description: Alternate section background used to separate content, e.g. “Pale” project cards. Warm sand in light mode, neutral in dark mode.

brand.$description: Brand-coloured border for emphasis, e.g. the focus state of secondary buttons.

default.$description: Neutral border for outlines that should not draw attention, e.g. the focus outline of primary buttons.

focus.$description: Focus and active indicator of interactive elements outside the button set, e.g. the underline of text links.

accent.$description: Decorative brand shapes with no meaning or interaction, e.g. the logo dot and the circle in Skills. Not for text or buttons.

default.$description: Default colour of standalone icons. Matches text/primary.

brand.$description: Brand-coloured display text, e.g. the Hero title. Large text only – not for body copy or links.

inverse.$description: Text placed on bg/inverse or other contrasting surfaces, e.g. footer copyright and links.

link-hover.$description: Hover colour of standalone text links, e.g. “find out more →”. For buttons use the action/* tokens.

primary.$description: Headings and high-emphasis text, e.g. section and card titles, Hero subtitle. Default choice for any text that must stand out.

secondary.$description: Body text and paragraphs, e.g. card descriptions, About and Skills copy. Use for running text.

figma.note: Figma text styles; values reference text primitives so they inherit the responsive font sizes.
